title: Wood Fired Portuguese Beef Bake
description: A smoky and festive Portuguese dish featuring mixed beef cuts, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven, kosher-friendly. This hearty dish is perfect for special occasions and gatherings.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the beef mixture to a large baking dish and pour in the red wine and beef broth.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the beef is tender and the top is browned.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the beef hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
